title: bardolier service list output
description: Attached services with their resolved host ports. cli-spec.md §6 (Services). Manifest plus catalogue only — no daemon is consulted, so it answers with Docker down.

attached_service.description: An attached service: the manifest's host port joined with the catalogue's identity. cli-spec.md §4.1, §4.2, §5. This block is duplicated verbatim in new/service-add/service-remove/service-list; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

host_port.description: The debugging tap on the Mac (§5). NOT what the dev app connects to.

data_dir.description: Absolute path of this service's data directory, <project>/data/<key> (phase 19).
